description: Interface measurement transport v1 (M3 Task 1). `valid` must parse unchanged in TS and Go; `normalization` maps an input sample to its parsed form (absent measurements become null with the not_reported reason, never 0); every `invalid` envelope must be rejected by both parsers.

normalization.name: absent measurements parse as null with a reason

invalid.name: counter sent as a JSON number
unavailable reason for a measured value
